risk_scale.HIGH: Can invalidate task/objective/candidate/evaluator parity or block materialization; must close before any run.
risk_scale.MEDIUM: Can invalidate reproducibility or comparability if unaddressed; requires a frozen control and parity evidence.
risk_scale.LOW: Bounded documentation or receipt risk that remains visible but does not by itself establish a semantic mismatch.

risks.finding: The v5 contracts do not freeze how views, purchases, repeated user-item events and interaction weights become BPR positives.
risks.closure_gate: Central freeze of one method-faithful event-folding rule plus fixture counts and hashes.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if closure changes BPR objective or uses TEST outcomes.

risks.finding: The complete catalog can plausibly be predeclared with global_iid_map, but no artifact proves 5,200-ID coverage or train-unseen cold score behavior.
risks.closure_gate: No-synthetic-interaction catalog-map fixture with exact coverage and finite-score evidence.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if cold items must be dropped or imputed outside the source scoring function.

risks.finding: The score seam is source-evidenced but no v5 shape, mask, tie, missingness or per-user metric parity receipt exists.
risks.closure_gate: Adversarial equal-score, seen-item, unknown-ID and manually checkable HR/NDCG/GAUC fixtures.
risks.failure_disposition: Remain COMPATIBILITY_INCOMPLETE until all fixtures pass.

risks.finding: Python/Cython/NumPy build compatibility and v5 CPU runtime are source-declared but untested.
risks.closure_gate: Immutable isolated environment lock and later authorized runtime receipt.
risks.failure_disposition: Do not modify the ai-service environment or silently change framework revision.

risks.finding: Frozen GitHub HTML blob locators had cache-miss replay failures; exact-commit raw alternatives replayed but do not erase the failed locator state.
risks.closure_gate: Central replay of each decision-bearing frozen locator or an explicitly frozen authoritative replacement locator.
risks.failure_disposition: Failed locator remains UNRESOLVED and cannot be promoted by inference.

rows.residual_risk: No materialization readiness; architectural BPR score-export feasibility only.

risks.finding: The four-column source schema is mappable, but the v5 positive-event and duplicate-collapse policy is not frozen.
risks.closure_gate: Central event-folding contract and deterministic TSV inventory/hash fixture.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if objective semantics are rewritten.

risks.finding: Pinned Dataset derives items from train_dict, omitting train-unseen cold catalog items.
risks.closure_gate: Bounded ID-map/model-allocation patch proving all catalog IDs are represented without synthetic interactions or TEST reads.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if the patch drops cold items, reads TEST, or imputes scores.

risks.finding: Dense factor scores exist before Elliot's own mask/top-k, but no exported v5 score artifact or parity receipt exists.
risks.closure_gate: Pre-mask score exporter plus shape/order/mask/tie/metric fixtures through the shared evaluator.
risks.failure_disposition: Source-native nDCG cannot substitute for the shared receipt.

risks.finding: The pinned dependency set is legacy and may not resolve on the current host/runtime.
risks.closure_gate: Isolated immutable container/environment with exact interpreter, dependency and hardware identities.
risks.failure_disposition: No package installation or version repair is authorized in FD4.

risks.finding: Frozen HTML commit/blob locators remain unreplayed; exact-commit raw owner files are separate successful evidence.
risks.closure_gate: Central replay or explicit authoritative locator replacement under change control.

rows.residual_risk: High environment and catalog-map risk; no execution or positive compatibility promotion.

risks.finding: MovieLens rating filtering does not define the v5 BPR positive set, and no v5 event-folding policy is frozen.
risks.closure_gate: Central positive-event/duplicate mapping with deterministic dataframe hashes.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if mapping changes the pairwise objective.

risks.finding: Pinned main.py concatenates train and test before deriving item_num, which is forbidden under the sealed v5 TEST boundary.
risks.closure_gate: Manifest-driven cardinality and pre-split driver proven never to read TEST while allocating every catalog item.
risks.failure_disposition: DISPOSITIVE_REJECT if TEST-derived identity discovery remains necessary.

risks.finding: Native candidate construction and torch.topk are not the v5 full-catalog deterministic-tie evaluator.
risks.closure_gate: Pre-top-k full score export and adversarial shared-evaluator fixtures.
risks.failure_disposition: No sampled-candidate or source-metric row may enter the harmonized table.

risks.finding: Broad torch lower bound plus old Cython/SciPy pins leave interpreter/CUDA resolution ambiguous.
risks.closure_gate: Exact isolated environment lock and later authorized CPU/GPU runtime receipt.
risks.failure_disposition: No silent model simplification or dependency substitution.

risks.finding: Frozen HTML code/result locators remain unreplayed; successful raw source replays do not change those locator-specific failures.
risks.closure_gate: Central exact-locator replay or controlled authoritative-locator replacement.

rows.residual_risk: A bounded no-TEST driver is plausible but not implemented; compatibility remains incomplete.
